newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-JADEJA HELPS INDIA AFTER EARLY COLLAPSE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JADEJA HELPS INDIA AFTER EARLY COLLAPSE.

text.p: A gallant 72 by Ajay Jadeja and a whirlwind 51 by all-rounder Robin Singh helped India reach 225 for seven after a disastrous start against Sri Lanka in their preliminary league match for the Independence Cup on Saturday.
Opener Saurav Ganguly was bowled first ball of the innings in the 50-over match and captain Sachin Tendulkar fell for two in the fourth over leaving India reeling at four for two wickets.
Left-hand medium pacer Chaminda Vaas bowled a miserly 10 overs giving away just 13 runs. Fellow opening bowler Sajeeva de Silva grabbed three wickets to tie down India.

A fighting stand of 95 runs in 21.5 overs for the fourth wicket between stylish batsman Rahul Dravid and Jadeja put India on the recovery path. Dravid scored 61 off 103 balls with eight fours before he was bowled by spinner Muthiah Muralitharan.
Jadeja continued the repair work adding 58 runs for the fifth wicket with Singh. He top-scored with 72, hitting four boundaries and a six.
Singh struck 51 off 52 balls with four hits to the ropes and one six as he scored his first 50 in 19 one-day internationals.
Wicket-keeper Nayan Mongia was unbeaten at 21 off 17 balls.
